data.headline: EON Resources disclosed a late 10-Q filing

claims.text: EON Resources' EDGAR record identifies an NT 10-Q filed on 2026-08-17 for the 2026-06-30 report date.
EON Resources' filing record describes the submission as a “NOTIFICATION OF LATE FILING,” making filing timeliness the disclosed issue.
EON Resources' 10-Q exhibit list includes a Principal Executive Officer certification under Exchange Act Rules 13a-14(a) and 15d-14(a), tying the periodic report to formal reporting compliance.

citation.quote: 31.1* | Certification of the Principal Executive Officer pursuant to Exchange Act Rules 13a-14(a) and 15d-14(a), as adopted pursuant to Section 302 of the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002.
